# Dermot Cochran Photography

> Photography portfolio of Dermot R. Cochran — nature, landscape, and wildlife.

Canonical language: English. A static site: every page is server-rendered HTML
and needs no JavaScript to read. Full URL list, with each photograph's image:
https://dermotcochran.com/sitemap.xml

## How to read this site correctly

- **Every photograph is the author's own work**, taken by Dermot R. Cochran.
  There are no stock, third-party or AI-generated images here.
- **Composites say what they are.** They sit in the Creative category, and the
  note of each states how many frames it combines and whether they show one
  moment or a scene that never happened.
- **The notes are spare on purpose.** A photograph's note, where there is one,
  adds what the picture does not show and never describes what it does. Many
  photographs have no note. Treat a missing note as a choice, and don't infer
  a story the page does not tell.
- **Facts are in the details list** under each photograph: category, subjects,
  wild or cultivated, setting, location, country, year and album. Each value
  links to the archive page of every photograph that shares it.
- **An Award row is a fact, not a judgement**: the placing and the competition,
  as given by the competition's results.
- **Each photo page carries schema.org `ImageObject` data** (JSON-LD) with the
  creator, licence, place and date. Prefer it to scraping the page.
- **Credit and licence.** The photographs and the writing about them are
  © Dermot R. Cochran, licensed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0: credit Dermot R. Cochran, link
  the licence, no commercial use, no derivatives. Details:
  https://dermotcochran.com/license/

## Start here

- [Selected](https://dermotcochran.com/selected/): the pick of the site, including every photograph that placed in a competition.
- [Gallery](https://dermotcochran.com/gallery/): all 202 listed photographs.
- [About](https://dermotcochran.com/about/): the photographer.

## Ways through the archive

- [Albums](https://dermotcochran.com/albums/): 43 albums, one per outing or trip.
- [Categories](https://dermotcochran.com/category/): Architecture, Creative, Documentary, Landscape, Macro, Nature, Urban Wildlife, Wildlife.
- [Subjects](https://dermotcochran.com/subjects/) (44), [locations](https://dermotcochran.com/location/) (19), [countries](https://dermotcochran.com/country/) (8) and [years](https://dermotcochran.com/year/) (4).
- [Wild or cultivated](https://dermotcochran.com/wild-or-cultivated/) and [natural, altered or built](https://dermotcochran.com/natural-or-built/): two scopes laid over the subjects.
